connector.name: Mainframe MCP Server
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for IBM z/OS jobs, datasets, USS, and operational diagnostics via Zowe SDK.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mainframe-mcp-server. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the notharshhaa account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: ZOSMF_HOST
env.description: z/OSMF hostname or IP address

env.name: ZOSMF_PORT
env.description: z/OSMF HTTPS port (default 443)

env.name: ZOSMF_BASE_PATH
env.description: Optional API gateway or mediation layer prefix for z/OSMF

env.name: ZOSMF_USER
env.description: z/OS user id (required with ZOSMF_PASSWORD unless ZOSMF_TOKEN is set)

env.name: ZOSMF_PASSWORD
env.description: Password for basic auth (required with ZOSMF_USER unless ZOSMF_TOKEN is set)

env.name: ZOSMF_TOKEN
env.description: Auth token (alternative to user/password)

env.name: ZOSMF_TOKEN_TYPE
env.description: Token type when using ZOSMF_TOKEN (e.g. LTPA2)

env.name: ZOSMF_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED
env.description: Verify TLS certificates (true in production)

env.name: LOG_LEVEL
env.description: Log level: fatal, error, warn, info, debug, trace, silent

env.name: MCP_TRANSPORT
env.description: Transport: stdio (IDE) or sse (container/network)

env.name: MCP_SSE_PORT
env.description: Listen port when MCP_TRANSPORT=sse

env.name: MAX_JOB_OUTPUT_LINES
env.description: Max lines returned from a single spool DD

env.name: MAX_DATASET_READ_LINES
env.description: Max lines returned from dataset or USS reads

env.name: MAX_JES_SPOOL_FILES
env.description: Max spool files fetched during diagnostics

env.name: MAX_AUDIT_LINES
env.description: Max RACF audit log lines per query

env.name: CMCI_CONTEXT
env.description: CICSplex name or region APPLID (required for CICS tools)

env.name: CMCI_HOST
env.description: CMCI hostname (defaults to ZOSMF_HOST)

env.name: CMCI_PORT
env.description: CMCI HTTPS port (default 1490)

env.name: CMCI_BASE_PATH
env.description: CMCI REST base path

env.name: DB2_LOCATION
env.description: Db2 subsystem location name (required for Db2 tools)

env.name: DB2_HOST
env.description: Db2 REST hostname (defaults to ZOSMF_HOST)

env.name: DB2_PORT
env.description: Db2 REST port (default 50400)

env.name: DB2_BASE_PATH
env.description: Db2 REST base path

env.name: SMF_SUMMARY_DATASET
env.description: Optional SMF summary dataset for offline metrics

env.name: RMF_METRICS_ENABLED
env.description: Query z/OSMF RMF metrics when available

env.name: RACF_AUDIT_USS_PATH
env.description: USS path to RACF audit log file

env.name: RACF_AUDIT_DATASET
env.description: Sequential dataset containing RACF audit records

env.name: SECURITY_READ_ONLY
env.description: When true, blocks write tools such as submit_jcl

env.name: SECURITY_ALLOWED_TOOLS
env.description: Comma-separated allowlist of MCP tool names

env.name: SECURITY_BLOCKED_TOOLS
env.description: Comma-separated blocklist of MCP tool names

env.name: SECURITY_ALLOWED_DATASET_PATTERNS
env.description: Comma-separated dataset patterns (e.g. USERDEV.*,SYS1.*)

env.name: SECURITY_ALLOWED_USS_PATHS
env.description: Comma-separated USS path prefixes

env.name: SECURITY_AUDIT_LOGGING
env.description: Log every tool invocation to stderr (SIEM-friendly JSON)

env.name: SECURITY_MAX_JCL_BYTES
env.description: Maximum inline JCL size for submit_jcl
